answer: Each account must carry one hand mirror along a wandering route to the vertex of a registered ridge. At the vertex a surveyor watches the mirror flash and signs the route record with the mirror serial mark. Two verifiers check the record and flash log against the survey register within a week, and a record tied to a second account voids both claims. The mirror and bond cost 3,000,000 rupiah, so 1,000 fake identities would spend 3,000,000,000 rupiah.
